# Sample dataset

Non-data file used to verify discovery excludes non-CSV/JSON files.

`budget_actions.csv` (009): accented, hyphenated and punctuated Portuguese budget names for
forgiving text filters, value suggestions and value lists
(specs/009-text-value-matching/contracts/). The second `nome_unidade` and the later
`data_ano` values appear only after row 20, outside the inspection sample.
